decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Before the development commences, the site shall be investigated by a competent person to identify the extent and nature of contamination on the land.  A detailed site investigation report shall be prepared and submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval with a scheme for decontamination should this be necessary.  The report shall include a tiered risk assessment of the contamination based on the proposed end use of the site.  The agreed scheme for decontamination, including amendments, must be fully implemented.
Condition : 4 - The site shall be divided into no more than five allotment plots
Condition : 5 - The existing trees on the site shall be retained and shall not be removed or lopped without the prior consent of the local planning authority

Condition : 6 - Notwithstanding the information contained in the application details of a revised parking scheme shall be submitted to and approved in writing to the Local Planning Authority before any work commences on site.  The revised scheme shall show the access points to have adequate sight lines on the street frontage, a reduction in the number of car parking spaces for the allotment users to three, and the boundary treatment between the car park, allotments, and the existing cottage and shall be implemented before the allotments are brought into use and permanently retained thereafter.

Condition : 7 - Before any work commences on site, a proposed site layout shall first be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority to show the proposed allotments and associated access arrangements, including details of paths and associated surfacing and details of one plot to be laid out in a manner suitable for use by a disabled person.  The site shall be laid out as approved before the use commences.
description: Change of use of garden area to allotment use and creation of new parking area and means of access to the highway
